feeds.title: Diary of a Sewing Fanatic
feeds.description: Carolyn is a sewist, dressmaker, fabricaholic and creative fiber artist, who loves to sew and has made everything from her wedding outfit, to coats, her daughter's and grandchildren's clothing as well a couple of home dec items.

feeds.title: Cookin' & Craftin'
feeds.description: A Plus Size Sewing Blog.

feeds.title: New Vintage Lady
feeds.description: I'm just one plus size woman who loves vintage. My take on vintage is the everyday. This space on the tubal interwebs is a bastion of early 1930s to mid 1940s sewing, fashion and lifestyle focusing on the Stout (plus sized) woman. I also like to chat about size in culture and race from time to time.

feeds.title: Crafting A Rainbow
feeds.description: I am Gillian. I love sewing and crafting of all kinds! I'm a teacher in small-town Ontario.

feeds.title: Bea's Sewing Adventures
feeds.description: I'm Beatrice and I'm a would-be born-again sewer. I'm a dancer and dance teacher, and my sewing of late has consisted mostly of dance costuming, which is a whole different kettle of beeswax from proper dressmaking.

feeds.title: Curvy Sewing Collective
feeds.description: Covers sewing tutorials, challenges, by a group of curvy sewing bloggers intent on demystifying all things plus-sized and home sewing. Curvy Sewing Collective is on a mission to get more curvy women sewing, blogging, & feeling fabulous!

feeds.title: Katrina Kay Creations
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Katrina Kellam. Are you tired of spending more time altering & fixing patterns than actually sewing? Or spending money on clothes that don't fit your curves? Then you've come to the right place. Here you will find posts to create Clothes That Fit Your Curves, Lifestyle. Get tutorials, worksheets and more on sewing & patternmaking for plus size women who sew.

feeds.title: Always a Crafty Lady
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Jessica. Wife, mother of two, and a woman obsessed with the art of making.

feeds.title: Idle Fancy
feeds.description: Covers sewing tutorials, fitting tutorials, snazzy dresses, sewing chatter by Mary, a lover of floral fabrics, vintage buttons, and awesome things.

feeds.title: Stitches and Seams
feeds.description: I'm Debbie Cook. I've sewn almost everything - home dec, quilting, gifts, lingerie & more, but sewing clothes for myself is what I really love and I sew most of my wardrobe because I have fun doing it and because it fits me better than anything I'd find in a store.

feeds.title: Mrs. Hughes
feeds.description: Covers retro inspired sewing, vintage patterns and adding modern twists to garments as well as incorporate heirloom and couture sewing techniques.

feeds.title: Pearl Red Moon Art
feeds.description: Mixed media artist who believes life is too short to wear boring clothes. I describe my own style as a mashup of hippie, bohemian, tribal/oriental/eastern, alternative arty with a bit of goth thrown in. Theres little affordable or flattering in boutiques for curvy creatives and the pattern companies mainly cater for the slender figure and conservative styling.

feeds.title: Someday Sewing
feeds.description: A Someday Sewing Blog.

feeds.title: Seams Like Style
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Nikki, and I'm so glad you're here because that means you have an interest in sewing, fashion and creating your own clothes! I'm a Stay at Home Mom that pattern tests for a few indie pattern designs. I like to support Plus Size designers and pretend I'm fashionable. Read more about how I got my start sewing.

feeds.title: MelodyMae.co.uk
feeds.description: A plus size sewing and style blog written by Andii Melody Mae.

feeds.title: Sew ChicPlus
feeds.description: A Plus Size Sewing & DIY Projects Blog.

feeds.title: G Marie
feeds.description: Hi - I'm gMarie. I love to sew my own clothing. My favorites are dresses. I love a fit and flare silhouette but am jonesing for a slim fitting sheath dress. In 2016 I would like to sew a coat, a jacket and finish my lace skirt. I also knit and am gMarie on Ravelry.

feeds.title: Foxgloves and thimbles
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Marianne. I love to sew and I like my garden. Sewing in the garden, the best of both worlds!

feeds.title: The Couture Counsellor
feeds.description: Just another blog from a red haired, 50-something, uber busty, slim hipped, funky lovin' sewist!

feeds.title: 10 sewing machines and a serger
feeds.description: Blogger, Sewist, Couture Enthusiast. I enjoy creating with quality fabrics and techniques to incorporate color, beauty and love into life!

feeds.title: Sew Modern Sew Historical
feeds.description: I am a 40 something wife and mom of boys. I have been sewing on and off for over 25 years. Everything from quilts to clothing. I also dabble in mixed media and knitting. But this blog will really be sewing focused. I make both modern and historical clothing. I am an old soul and very fond of the late Victorian bustle area. I also adore the mid to late 18th century.

feeds.title: Fruit From My Hands
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Aleeah. I am a sewist, a maker, a pattern designer and a confessed fabric and yarn hoarder. I am part of the Middle generation we are the smallest generation and we do not identify with the Baby Boomers.

feeds.title: Craftastrophies
feeds.description: A Plus Size Sewing Blog.

feeds.title: Get My Stitch On
feeds.description: I recently moved back to the US after living in India for 3 years. During my Indian adventure, I started sewing again after a long hiatus. I've decided to blog about how I've been getting my stitch on!

feeds.title: Small Seams
feeds.description: Hi! I am Jewel; a College Librarian, wife and a mother of two small girls. I love creating beautiful, useful and well-loved items for the small people in my life. My new venture? Sewing for MYSELF!

feeds.title: U&Mii
feeds.description: In the fashion world I am 'plus size'. Yes, siree, I've got curves and I'm not afraid to use 'em! I love that by sewing I can make unique clothes that I would never find in any shop, and make them so they actually fit me. What a revolutionary thought! After all, why shouldn't everyone rock their own personal style, regardless of size?
